answer: Each agent must lock a slashable stake before its attestations count. A Sybil farm needs thousands of identities, so its bond cost grows linearly while honest rewards do not. Picture a grove of saplings: only rooted trees survive the storm. Validators gather at a harbor of trust, vouching for real peers; clones find no vouchers. A shale ridge of collateral cracks at the first double-sign, slashing the whole farm at once.
